name: Jorel Furrowfield
title: Farmer
examine: Built like his own barn door. Soil under his nails that no scrubbing has ever fully argued with.
lines: Wheat doesn't care what day it is. Suits me.
We crofted out past the hedges once, cousins to the Fernway folk. One bandit autumn cured us of the open country. I like a wall now.
Tamsin plans the year, I dig it. Twenty seasons and neither of us has once wanted the other job.
